messages:
alexa_cs: Heads-up: Peregrine Labs onboarding stalled — their SDK init in staging keeps returning 401s, then a couple 429s. They hit this after switching to our browser SDK v1.2.0 and adding ephemeral tokens.

mike_eng: @alexa_cs can you paste the exact error log from their console? also which region and API key scope?

alexa_cs: Julian (Peregrine) pasted this: `Error: 401 Unauthorized - invalid_scope` then later `429 Too Many Requests` when they retried fast. Region: us-west-2, using ephemeral key flow, scope set to `inference:generate` only.

sara_se: thanks. quick checklist: 1) verify token issuer (we had a recent clock skew issue with some clients) 2) scope vs route mismatch 3) preflight fanout causing thundering retries.

mike_eng: can we check the token introspection logs? @tim_ops do we have traces for their api_key_id `ak_789...`?

tim_ops: pulling logs now — saw repeated 401s at 2026-03-18T14:02:12Z from the same client IP. Token validation failed with `scope_missing: embeddings` (odd). Also see a burst of preflight requests at 14:02:15Z, ~120 reqs/min, triggering edge rate limiter and a few 429s.

alexa_cs: they said they only call chat/generate endpoints. Why would the token require embeddings?

mike_eng: likely their SDK is hitting the /embeddings route for a health check or telemetry. ask them to run a request capture or grep for `/v1/embeddings` in the bundle.

sara_se: suggested quick mitigation to Peregrine: 1) stop client retries (backoff) 2) ensure token scopes include `embeddings` if their client calls it 3) upgrade to SDK v1.3.1 which silences auto-probes.

alexa_cs: sent those recommendations. they replied with their local stacktrace snippet: ```
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
})
.catch(e => console.log(e));
```

mike_eng: there we go — their app is indeed calling embeddings. two follow-ups: are they deliberately probing or a 3rd-party lib is doing it? also we should check our edge rate limiter config — we recently tightened burst windows in us-west-2.

tim_ops: edge config note: burst_window lowered to 10s for infra reasons last week. that means many small probes + instant retries will trip. I can temporarily raise the window for their tenant or whitelist their IP while they finish onboarding.

alexa_cs: that would help. I'll ask Peregrine to stop retries and confirm if the embedding call is from a vendor. If they want whitelist, we need ip + acct id.

sara_se: for longer term, we'll add a short onboarding doc pointer: <https://internal.redwood/docs/onboard/token-scopes-and-probing> and recommend SDK upgrade. Also noting this as a renewal-risk flag: early auth flakiness increases churn if not resolved in 24-48h.

mike_eng: action items: 1) @tim_ops temporary whitelist / raise burst window for acct `acct_peregrine` 2) @alexa_cs send repro checklist + ask for `grep /embeddings` output and their SDK bundle version 3) @sara_se prepare a short diff note for docs team to call out auto-probes

tim_ops: started a temporary policy change — raised burst_window to 30s for acct_peregrine. will rollback in 48h unless we hear otherwise.

alexa_cs: Peregrine confirmed they found a vendor analytics lib hitting embeddings as a probe. they disabled it and retried — no more 401s, no 429s.

sara_se: awesome. marking as resolved but leaving a follow-up in our onboarding tracker to ensure docs + SDK patch in next release. :tada:

deploy-bot: Deployment note: edge policy change applied to acct_peregrine by tim_ops at 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z.
